Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Safety update: AutoBuy now stops when the main Market Board window closes, throttles repeated UI actions, prefers the visible Market Board result order before opening items, and no longer tries to show the item-search agent while the search UI is unavailable.
